name: 寂明寺（暂名）
status: draft; not implemented; positions to be fixed after the first whitebox
origin: the centre of the 大雄殿 front column line; hall floor y=0; courtyard y=-3.0
height_note: ground_m is the local floor's approximate absolute elevation: courtyard 67.0 and hall/月台 70.0, derived from SRTM ~70 m (±5-10 m) and the documented 3 m platform; eye_m is above that floor. SRTM cannot resolve the platform. Do not treat either as survey data.
season_time: whitebox neutral daylight first; then T05-J01 winter-clear with F01 entrance diffuse light; T05-J02 after snow as a separate variant; see ART.md

cameras.name: 院落远望
cameras.purpose: first sight of the nine-bay hall; the platform and the roof read together; the interior is not yet visible
must_show: 单檐五脊庑殿顶与青灰瓦
must_not: 把 T00/T01 的殿式刷成赭红当 T05
cameras.notes: The hall is 48.2 m wide and about 21 m to the ridge; from 55 m a 50° lens at +11° holds the platform base to the ridge. This is the 'big, but cannot see inside' beat.

cameras.name: 台基
cameras.purpose: the 3 m platform presses the visitor down; the door is a narrow dark band above
must_not: 把台基做成 T00 的薄台
cameras.notes: The ridge is deliberately out of frame; the visitor should feel the platform's height first. Steps are 18 risers, 0.16–0.17 m each, as a proposal.

cameras.name: 殿门中央
cameras.purpose: the threshold; the door frame crops the row; the first faces come out of the dark
cameras.notes: At about 19 m from the altar, a 50° lens covers about 18 m across: the central three, not the seven. This is the 'first face' beat; do not back out too far.

cameras.name: 侧向观看
cameras.purpose: walk the east aisle; the seven are seen in profile and are visibly different
must_not: 把胁侍做成弟子／梵天／帝释
把七尊做成一样的侧影
cameras.notes: Yaw 305° looks north-west along the row; the east wall is behind the camera. This is the 'they are not the same' beat.

cameras.name: 仰视梁架
cameras.purpose: under the inner bay, look up: no ceiling, the whole frame is exposed
must_show: 彩画飞天／网目纹／宝相花
cameras.notes: Pitch 58°; keep the central Buddha's head at the bottom edge if possible. This is the 'from human scale to the roof' beat.

cameras.name: 回到中央
cameras.purpose: back on the axis; the order is understood, but the seven still cannot fit in one frame
must_show: 两侧尽间各一尊的局部
cameras.notes: Even at 65°, the 48.2 m hall is wider than the frame. If evidence needs the whole row, use a three-frame stitch or a pan, not an in-game ultra-wide.

route_note: The hall is 48.2 m wide and the seven span about 38 m; no single 44–65° frame shows all seven. The whole is understood by walking, not by one camera. A three-frame panorama may be used in evidence, not as an in-game camera.
to_verify_after_whitebox: every camera stands on walkable ground
cam01 holds the platform base to the ridge
cam02 keeps the ridge out of frame
cam03 shows the central three without cutting the central Buddha's head
cam04 has a clear side aisle of at least 3 m
cam05 does not clip the beams or the roof
cam06 does not claim to show all seven
the door light is a narrow band, not a wash
the hall reads as nine bays, not seven or five
the roof reads as a single-eave hip roof with grey tiles
